name: im-non-resident-income-tax
description: Use this skill for Isle of Man income tax on individuals who are not resident in the Island, for the 2026/27 tax year (6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027). It covers the 21% non-resident rate with no personal allowance, which Manx income is taxable and which is excluded (Manx bank interest, Manx company dividends, the Manx State Pension), the section 11A limit on tax, the non-resident return due 6 October, payer deductions under notice N15 with forms N13, N20, N35 and N37, the HR code for non-resident employees, pension relief on form R221, and the UK treaty rules on residence, employment, directors, pensions, government service, entitlement and mutual agreement. Trigger on: Isle of Man non-resident tax, Manx rent non-resident landlord, N15 notice, R221 pension relief, HR tax code, UK resident with Isle of Man pension. Out of scope: residents (im-income-tax), companies and permanent establishments (im-corporate-income-tax), National Insurance (im-payroll-social).
